description: Customers wait too long at billing; too few counters open; slow scanning.
examples: Waited 40 min at billing, only 2 counters open | Q at POS too long in evening peak

description: Not enough staff on the floor or at counters; absenteeism; shift gaps.
examples: No one in fruits section to weigh | 3 staff absent today, managed with 2 tills

description: Staff indifferent, ignore customers, do not know products or policies (no abuse or cheating).
examples: Asked for ragi flour, staff just shrugged | Floor boy did not know about the offer

description: Abusive language, shouting, harassment, physical aggression, deliberate overcharging or cheating by staff.
examples: Billing staff shouted and used abusive language | Guard called a customer a thief in front of everyone

description: Internal staff grievances: salary or incentive delays, overtime, weekly off, breaks, uniforms.
examples: Salary not credited yet | Weekly off cancelled again for 2 staff

issue_type: Hygiene lapse (pests, dirty food areas, foul smell)
description: Pests (cockroaches, rats, flies), dirty food counters or bakery, foul smell, unclean washroom.
examples: Cockroach near bakery counter | Rat droppings in the grocery aisle

description: Clutter, cartons in aisles, messy or unlabelled shelves, broken trolleys (no hygiene risk).
examples: Cartons lying in every aisle | Shelves are a mess, cannot find anything

issue_type: Physical safety hazard (wet floor, wiring, falling stock)
description: Slip or trip hazards, wet floors, exposed wiring, falling stock, blocked fire exit, broken glass.
examples: Floor wet near entrance, no caution board | Loose wire hanging near billing

description: Water leaking from roof or AC ducts, seepage on walls or shelves, buckets kept in aisles.
examples: Water dripping from ceiling in aisle 6 | Seepage on the wall behind atta shelf

description: Freezer or chiller not cooling; frozen goods thawed or melted; dairy warm or spoiled because of temperature.
examples: Ice cream tubs soft and dripping | Chiller showing 14 degrees, curd sour

issue_type: Equipment breakdown (AC, lift, lights, scale, POS)
description: Non-refrigeration equipment broken: AC, lift/escalator, lights, weighing scale, billing machine, card machine.
examples: AC not working, store very hot | Weighing scale in veg section showing error

description: Complaints about being charged for carry bags, poor packing at checkout.
examples: Charged Rs 15 for a carry bag without asking | Eggs packed under heavy items

description: Parking problems, entry/exit access, ramp, store opened late or closed early.
examples: No parking space, guard rude about it | Store closed at 9:30 though board says 10

description: Regular items not available, empty shelves, repeated stock-outs.
examples: Toor dal out of stock for a week | Milk over by 9 am every day

description: Rotten or stale fruits, vegetables, bread; poor fresh quality (not temperature-related).
examples: Half the tomatoes were rotten | Bananas black inside

description: Expired or about-to-expire items on shelf or delivered; old stock not rotated.
examples: Bread on shelf was 2 days past expiry | Got biscuits that expired last month

description: Insects, stones, hair, plastic, glass or metal pieces found in a product.
examples: Found worms in the atta | Small stone in rice packet

description: Wrong or missing ingredient/allergen information, wrong veg/non-veg mark, label does not match contents.
examples: Green veg dot on a product that contains egg | Sesame present but not declared on the label

issue_type: Shelf price vs bill price mismatch
description: Price on shelf tag differs from price charged at billing; wrong price tags.
examples: Shelf said Rs 99, billed Rs 120 | Old price tags still on shelf

description: Advertised offer, discount or buy-one-get-one not applied at billing or online.
examples: Buy 1 get 1 on shampoo not given | 20% off on oil not applied in bill

description: Saffron own-brand (Saffron Select / Saffron Kitchen) products: taste, texture, quantity, packaging quality.
examples: Saffron Select atta makes hard rotis | Saffron Kitchen namkeen packet half empty

description: Store does not carry a product or variety customers want (not a temporary stock-out).
examples: Please keep Jain products | No sugar-free options at all

issue_type: Online order delivery delay / missed slot
description: Home delivery late, missed slot, order not delivered.
examples: Ordered for 7-9 pm slot, came next morning | Order still not delivered

issue_type: Wrong or missing items in online order
description: Items missing from delivery, wrong item or wrong variant delivered, substitution without consent.
examples: 2 items missing from my order | Got toned milk instead of full cream

issue_type: Damaged or leaking items on delivery
description: Items arrived broken, crushed, leaking or with torn packaging.
examples: Oil pouch leaking all over the bag | 4 eggs broken

issue_type: App / website crash, login or bug
description: App or website not opening, crashing, login/OTP problems, cart or search bugs.
examples: App crashes at checkout | OTP not coming

issue_type: Payment failure / money debited but order failed
description: UPI/card payment failed, amount debited without order or bill, double debit.
policy_reason: customer money held without service (RBI turn-around-time rules for failed digital payments)
examples: Money debited but order failed | UPI failed at counter but amount deducted

description: Refund or return pending, refund amount wrong, no update on refund.
examples: Refund pending for 12 days | Returned item but refund not received

description: Saffron Rewards points not credited or not redeemable, coupon code not working.
examples: Points not credited for last 3 bills | Coupon code shows invalid

issue_type: Billing error at counter (double scan, wrong weight/qty)
description: Honest billing mistakes at the counter: item scanned twice, wrong weight or quantity, wrong variant billed.
examples: Milk scanned twice | Billed 2 kg onions, I took 1 kg

description: Positive feedback; nothing to fix.
examples: Great store, staff very helpful | Fresh veggies today

description: Neutral comments, questions, routine notes, second-hand chatter; not an operational problem.
examples: When will you open in Wakad? | Handover done, all ok

description: Spam, adverts, gibberish, content unrelated to the store.
examples: Earn 5000 daily from home click link | asdf
